_comment: Art pass 2026-10-02, batch P: world pickups that read as objects instead of labelled boxes.
Plan: docs/plans/art-pass-20261002.md. The reviewed low-quality medkit test is the style
reference for every item; weapon pickups also reference their approved first-person idle so
the same gun reads the same in the world. image_urls are temporary uploads recorded in
Each upload:<file> stood for a temporary provider URL of that local keeper. To rerun, upload the keeper with fragr-spritegen upload and substitute its public URL.
style: retro pixel art item pickup sprite for a 1990s PC shooter in the same chunky pixel style as the reference picture, crisp stepped pixel clusters, limited palette of desaturated bone white, gunmetal grey, rust, ember, blood red and deep shadow with clear value contrast, flat even lighting, no gradients
view: three-quarter view from slightly above, resting on the floor, centred, the whole object visible with even margins
technical: the whole background is one flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF colour with no checkerboard, no pattern, no gradient and no shadow on it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border

frames.subject: the same compact hard-shell medical kit case as the reference picture, bone-white enamel shell, dark steel corner guards and a carry handle, one bold blood-red horizontal pulse-line mark across the lid, no cross symbol
a salvaged ballistic chest plate vest lying flat, broad dark gunmetal armour plates with bone-white edge trim, worn warm brown leather straps and steel buckles, rivets and scuffs
a small open dark steel ammunition box packed with rows of brass pistol and rifle rounds, a few loose brass rounds beside it
a small worn rust-red cardboard box of shotgun shells with its lid open, red shells with brass bases standing inside and two lying beside it
a squat heavy energy cell canister standing upright, dark steel casing with bone-white end caps, a glowing pale cyan window band around its middle and a carry loop on top
two squat service hand grenades lying together, muted sage-green steel bodies, dark steel caps with safety levers and steel ring pins
